scientific_integrity: Exact theorem supported by a dimension-independent proof. Finite numerical checks are corroborative, not a proof for all sizes; originality requires independent priority review.
scientific_limitations: Only uniform complete-graph hopping and Markovian site-basis dephasing, n>=3.
Spectral-gap optimum is not a finite-time mixing-distance optimum.
Two-site and zero-dephasing boundary cases are outside the theorem.
title: Exact optimal dephasing for complete-graph quantum-walk relaxation
